title: OLEANDER Lighting Design Process v1.0
purpose: Run authentic architectural-lighting development from scope, people, place and visual-task basis through creative concept, scheme, cross-disciplinary coordination, technical design, conditional prototyping, production support, commissioning/aiming/measurement and in-use review while preserving evidence, electrical, fire, integration and statutory boundaries.
scope_in: visual task, visibility and spatial lighting experience
daylight and electric-light integration within appointment scope
brightness/darkness hierarchy, glare, colour and material appearance
lighting controls intent, scenes and time states
lighting mockups, samples and aiming benchmarks
lighting commissioning, aiming, measurement and handover
post-occupancy lighting performance and maintenance review
scope_out: automatic fire/life-safety or emergency-lighting statutory approval
automatic daylight field truth from simulation
automatic health outcome from integrative-lighting metrics
automatic field verification beyond actual readback
automatic Design KEEP, Integration PASS or Promotion
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Architecture Map v2.1, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Shared Design Quality, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project appointment and applicable jurisdiction/professional authority.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires professional judgment about light, darkness, visibility, visual experience, daylight-electric integration, lighting controls, lighting product/optical performance, commissioning or in-use lighting performance.
responsibility_triggers: lighting decision controls another discipline or package
lighting product/photometric/control claim has project consequence
installed lighting performance or field measurement is claimed
lighting mockup or commissioning decision affects downstream acceptance
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable valid claim boundary across appointment scope, mounted lighting/daylight/product evidence, interface maturity, native lighting evidence, mockup/commissioning/readback, decision authorization and external statutory/professional authority governs the specific lighting claim; opaque claim text is not numerically ranked.
not_triggered_when: reference-only lighting imagery with explicit exclusion of professional lighting-design claims
pure electrical circuit work that makes no lighting-design or visual-performance claim

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential lighting, daylight, human-visual, product/photometric, controls, energy, emergency-lighting, environmental, maintenance and integrative-lighting evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional lighting decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER Design Quality and Professional Domain Process contracts
SLL lighting design-process and delivery guidance
theory_routes: light, darkness, luminance hierarchy and spatial experience
colour, material, reflectance and surface appearance
source_routes: SLL LG23 Design, Creativity and Compliance
SLL LG14 Control of Electric Lighting
SLL Integrative Lighting Position Statement August 2026
standard_code_routes: Notion A33 GB/T 50034-2024 when applicable to China projects
precedent_case_routes: project-type lighting precedents admitted through Current Knowledge routing with explicit transfer limits

stages.professional_question: What must light enable, reveal, protect or avoid, for whom, where, when, and under what evidence and authority boundary?
entry_conditions: Lighting professional responsibility is triggered or its applicability requires resolution.
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Task/claim-scoped Knowledge/OE mount is required before consequential lighting criteria or professional closure are asserted.
required_native_outputs: lighting design question and open-items record

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material Architecture scope/space/opening/design-intent change reopens affected Lighting basis consumers.

human_experience_consequences: visual task, orientation, comfort and perception requirements become explicit
design_language_consequences: light/darkness role in Project Design DNA becomes bounded and explicit where applicable
technical_consequences: measurement/calculation/mockup/commissioning obligations and claim ceilings are identified
content_projection_requirements: separate facts, assumptions, design intent, criteria, unresolved items and does-not-prove boundaries
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner within current authorization/competence scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review when material claim/risk/promotion trigger requires it; independence and competence basis must be resolvable.
open_items_allowed: detailed photometric criteria not yet required at this ceiling
exit_conditions: lighting problem/scope/users/tasks/time states and responsibility boundaries are explicit

stages.professional_question: What light-and-darkness logic generates the intended spatial perception and experience?
entry_conditions: Current Lighting basis and design question exist.
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential precedent/theory/product claims require current task/claim mount before driving selection.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Current design-intent and native spatial/material artifacts
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material design-intent/spatial/material change reopens affected lighting concept relations.

human_experience_consequences: brightness/darkness hierarchy, orientation, focal emphasis and transitions are intentionally designed
design_language_consequences: lighting becomes a generative part of design language rather than decorative fixture selection
technical_consequences: technical risks and prototype/calculation needs generated by concept are explicit
content_projection_requirements: concept mechanism and alternatives must be explained; render alone is insufficient
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner within current authorization/competence scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent design/process review when triggered; machine cannot award concept quality.
exit_conditions: selected lighting concept has project-specific generative logic
experience and interface consequences are explicit

stages.professional_question: Can the lighting concept become a coherent system across tasks, spaces, time states and daylight conditions?
entry_conditions: Lighting concept is selected at current claim ceiling.
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Lighting criteria/product evidence used to support consequential scheme decisions requires current Operational Mount.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Current Lighting scheme plus MEP/Electrical native system artifacts
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material electrical/controls/system constraint change reopens affected scheme variables.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Current geometry/daylight evidence and Lighting daylight-electric strategy
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material opening/shading/daylight-assumption change reopens affected daylight-electric strategy.

human_experience_consequences: visual tasks, comfort and temporal experience are translated into a coherent scheme
design_language_consequences: lighting hierarchy and fixture visibility/integration are systematized across spaces/states
content_projection_requirements: scheme drawings distinguish design intent, calculated evidence, assumptions and open interfaces
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner within current authorization/competence scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review when scheme claim/risk/promotion trigger requires it.
exit_conditions: material interfaces and prototype/technical questions are explicit

stages.professional_question: Are lighting-controlled variables coordinated with the physical and operational systems that must carry them?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential interface criteria and product constraints require current Knowledge/OE mounts where knowledge-derived.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: R-F Cross-Disciplinary Integration interface state plus domain-native artifacts
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: R-F or controlling-domain change reopens only Lighting consumers of affected interface relations.

human_experience_consequences: coordination preserves intended light position, visibility, control and user operation
design_language_consequences: fixture/detail integration and lighting hierarchy survive interdisciplinary coordination
technical_consequences: mounting/power/control/access/emergency/maintenance interfaces are explicitly resolved or held
content_projection_requirements: interface state and blockers must remain co-located with affected lighting decision; no hidden appendix contradiction
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner for Lighting-controlled variables; R-F retains integration truth
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review when interface criticality/claim requires it; reviewer may not self-award R-F state.
open_items_allowed: interfaces explicitly allowed OPEN by current claim ceiling
exit_conditions: required interfaces meet current Lighting-stage maturity or have explicit allowed disposition
reopen_triggers: any controlling interface variable or disposition materially changes

stages.professional_question: Is the lighting intent technically specified, modelled, coordinated, serviceable and bounded by current evidence?
entry_conditions: Lighting scheme and required coordination are mature enough for detailed design.
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: All consequential technical/product/standard claims require current task/claim mounts with freshness and claim boundary.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Current Lighting technical artifacts and Electrical/MEP native artifacts
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material electrical/controls/product-interface change reopens affected technical Lighting outputs.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Current fire/life-safety authority artifacts plus Lighting emergency-interface artifacts
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material fire/egress/emergency-lighting strategy change reopens affected Lighting technical scope.

human_experience_consequences: visual comfort, visibility, colour/material perception and user control are technically carried into deliverables
design_language_consequences: detail, fixture integration, light distribution and control states retain the selected design language
technical_consequences: photometric, product, energy, controls, maintenance and measurement requirements are explicit and reviewable
content_projection_requirements: technical figures preserve units, planes, assumptions, legend, source/product revision and claim limitation
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner within current authorization/competence scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent technical/professional review when material risk or promotion trigger requires it.
open_items_allowed: approved bounded production details not yet issued
exit_conditions: detailed design is internally coherent and bounded by current evidence

stages.professional_question: Has a material uncertainty that cannot be responsibly closed on paper been tested under a bounded representative setup?
entry_conditions: Prototype/mockup applicability is explicitly TRIGGERED for a material Lighting claim.
knowledge_inputs: test/measurement method appropriate to the claim
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Any test criterion/evidence used for professional decision requires current task/claim mount as applicable.
required_native_outputs: bounded design decision and limitation record
interface_requirements: product/material/architecture/interior/landscape/controls variables needed to make setup representative

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Exact mockup/prototype setup and readback plus current source artifacts
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Change to a variable that made the mockup representative invalidates only dependent mockup conclusions.

human_experience_consequences: actual perceived effect can challenge or confirm design assumptions at tested scope
design_language_consequences: lighting signature/detail/material-light relationship can be evaluated at representative scale
content_projection_requirements: setup conditions, revisions, observations/measurements, decision and limitations must be co-reported
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner for the tested claim within current authorization/competence scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent mockup review when the tested decision itself is promotion/material-risk critical.
open_items_allowed: untested contexts outside the representative setup
exit_conditions: test question is answered or explicitly remains unresolved
tested-scope limitation and downstream consequence are recorded
reopen_triggers: product/geometry/material/control/ambient condition changes outside allowed variation

stages.professional_question: Does procurement/production preserve the current lighting intent and technical boundary?
entry_conditions: Lighting procurement/production review is within appointment and triggered.
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Substitution/product evidence used for consequential approval/recommendation requires current Operational Mount.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Current Lighting technical design plus actual submitted product/fabrication evidence
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Any material substitution reopens all dependent concept/photometric/detail/control/maintenance claims.

human_experience_consequences: substitution review checks whether spatial/visual effect and user operation are preserved
design_language_consequences: value engineering cannot silently erase design-language-critical lighting moves
technical_consequences: equivalent lumen/output alone is rejected as sufficient equivalency evidence
content_projection_requirements: approval/revise/reject basis and reopened claims must be explicit
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner within appointed production-review authority
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review when substitution affects material risk/claim or independent-review scope.
open_items_allowed: site commissioning/aiming evidence not yet available
exit_conditions: production proposal is accepted/revised/rejected within authority
downstream impacts and reopen scope are explicit

stages.stage_name: Installation Readback / Commissioning / Aiming / Measurement / Handover
stages.professional_question: Does the installed Lighting system actually realise the bounded design intent and functional requirements?
entry_conditions: Lighting installation is sufficiently complete for the claimed commissioning/readback scope.
required_inputs: commissioning plan and required test conditions
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Commissioning criteria/test methods and consequential product/authority claims require current Operational Mount.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Actual installed-system commissioning/readback plus current domain artifacts
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Commissioning contradiction or installed-system change reopens only dependent Lighting/controls/interface claims.

human_experience_consequences: actual aiming, brightness, controls and user operation are read back rather than inferred from documentation
design_language_consequences: field aiming/scene tuning must preserve bounded design intent
technical_consequences: pre-commissioning, functional testing, measurements, interface tests, operator training and defects become actual evidence
content_projection_requirements: measured value must carry unit, location/plane, instrument/method/condition and limitation as applicable
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner within commissioning/readback appointment; external/statutory owners retain their authority
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent commissioning/performance review when material claim or promotion trigger requires it.
open_items_allowed: bounded seasonal/in-use checks explicitly deferred to LGT-INUSE
exit_conditions: declared commissioning postconditions are actually read back
affected defects/open items are explicit and compatible with claim ceiling

stages.professional_question: Does Lighting continue to support people, design intent and operation across relevant actual use and maintenance states?
entry_conditions: In-use review is triggered and the installation is occupied/operated under a meaningful observation condition.
required_inputs: occupant/operator or measured evidence as applicable
knowledge_inputs: current integrative-lighting evidence if such claims are made
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential in-use/health/performance claims require current evidence mount and explicit evidence maturity.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: Actual operational/maintenance evidence and Lighting in-use readback
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Material operational/use/maintenance change reopens only affected in-use Lighting conclusions.

human_experience_consequences: actual user/visual-task/comfort/control outcomes can challenge design assumptions
design_language_consequences: time, maintenance and changed use can reveal whether Lighting language remains coherent in operation
technical_consequences: degradation, failure, replacement, control use and measured performance can trigger bounded repair/reopen
content_projection_requirements: separate measured/observed evidence from inference, assumption, satisfaction report and health claim
stages.professional_review_owner: Lighting Design professional owner within current in-use review scope
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review when in-use conclusion supports a material professional/promotion/knowledge-return claim.
open_items_allowed: future seasonal/time-state conditions outside observed window
exit_conditions: bounded in-use question is answered or explicitly held
changed assumptions and reopen scope are recorded

controlling_authority_requirements: R-F owns actual interface maturity/disposition and acceptance
Lighting cannot self-award another domain or statutory PASS
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Each Lighting stage declares required interface maturity for its decision; actual maturity/disposition remains exclusively in Current Cross-Disciplinary Integration state.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: open interface is explicitly compatible with current Lighting claim ceiling
open item has owner, impact and reopen condition
no hidden critical contradiction supports closure
integration_readback_requirements: affected acceptance/reopen readback when interface changes

native_source_of_truth_rules: native editable/calculation/control/readback artifact governs over presentation derivative
render cannot substitute for calculation or field readback
controller state cannot substitute for actual emitted-light readback when output is material
execution_owner_requirements: Lighting execution owner must be competent for the actual task and decision scope
consequential mutation/review must resolve current authorization basis
tool_adapter_requirements: use the Current Skill/Capability/Tool Resolver rather than a hardcoded tool inventory
tool execution must preserve source revision and actual readback
multi-surface mutations follow Current coherent reconciliation rules
typed_handoff_contracts: R-D to R-E shared DD/DNA input
R-E to R-F Lighting interface requirements
R-E to R-G/H required native output and capability route
R-H/I readback/review back to R-E claim closure
actual_readback_requirements: read back native Lighting artifacts after mutation
read back calculated/model outputs that support claims
read back actual mockup/commissioning/field outputs when claimed
recovery closure requires declared postcondition readback

assurance.professional_review: Lighting professional review of concept mechanism, human visual task/experience, daylight-electric integration, photometric assumptions, glare/colour/material relationship, controls, product/optics, interfaces, mockup, production substitutions, commissioning and in-use consequences within actual authority.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify current Knowledge/OE mounts, product/photometric source revision, model assumptions, measurement/test conditions, field-readback provenance and evidence maturity for non-visual claims.
technical_gates: commissioning/measurement readback when installed performance is claimed
assurance.independent_review: Required when triggered by material professional/design/promotion risk; exact reviewer independence/competence/authorization basis must be resolved under Current v2.1 decision-authorization semantics.
assurance.receipt_contract: Use the Current Professional Domain process/stage instance and professional receipt envelope; do not invent a Lighting-specific replacement runtime state family unless separately governed.

stale_scope_rules: mark only Lighting stages/outputs/receipts that consumed the changed relation stale
stale dependent handoff cannot support Promotion
upstream_impact_rules: reopen R-B/R-C/R-D only when the Lighting contradiction reveals their consumed knowledge/intent/DD relation is materially invalid
do not use downstream Lighting change as automatic whole-system reset
downstream_impact_rules: reopen affected R-F interfaces, R-G/H execution outputs, R-I reviews and R-J promotion claims that consume changed Lighting relation
interface_reopen_rules: only consumers of changed controlled/shared variable reopen
receipt_stale_rules: professional receipt becomes stale when a consumed controlling relation changes materially
recovery incident closure does not silently reinterpret prior receipt

process_exit_conditions: all triggered Lighting stages satisfy exit/terminal conditions at claim scope
required native outputs and actual readback exist
material R-F interfaces are compatible with claim ceiling
installed-performance claims have commissioning/measurement evidence where applicable
open_items_allowed: explicit bounded items compatible with claim ceiling and carrying owner/impact/reopen condition
future seasonal/in-use observations outside current claim
completion_contract.professional_receipt: Current Lighting professional-domain receipt compiled through the existing Professional Domain Process runtime envelope.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Lighting process PASS is only one owner-scoped promotion dependency when triggered; it cannot award Design KEEP, Integration PASS, statutory approval or Promotion.
completion_contract.claim_ceiling: Lowest applicable valid owner-scoped boundary for the specific Lighting claim, including actual appointment, evidence, interface, readback, commissioning and external-authority limits.
